text: I can't recommend this place enough.
Not a single dull moment in the whole show.
There was nothing I didn't love about it.
Never have I had a better night out.
The staff couldn't have been kinder.
A joy from start to finish.
Best decision we made all week.
The food was cold and the waiter was rude.
We left early and regretted going at all.
The room smelled of damp and the wifi failed.
The sequel ruined everything the original built.
Two hours I will never get back.
